resources.string: Turns the Titan\'s touch-sensitive keyboard into a touchpad. Shows an on-screen pointer, taps where it points, and watches key presses so typing is not mistaken for touchpad use and so a shortcut key can toggle the pointer. Nothing is collected or sent anywhere.
Keeps the pointer working when the app is closed. Long-press to hide; the pointer keeps working.
TitanPointer lost keyboard focus to another window, so it can\'t see keyboard touches here. Toggle pointer mode to retry.
Pointer off: type away. Use your shortcut or the tile to bring it back.
